segments.text: We first tried Data analytics dashboard in 207. At the time, competition mattered because we wanted to stop stock-outs during festive seasons.
The biggest issue was FX volatility. Without steady power in Abuja, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after Data analytics dashboard—we saw Cost reduction within 8 months.
Policy-wise, Regulatory licenses shaped our move. We adjusted by Pilot then scale.
Data helped; even a Excel-based trendline gave us clearer demand patterns during Easter.
